78.english_meaning: The study of places and the relationships between people and their environments.

78.english_meaning: Important, serious, or significant in size, amount, or scale.

78.english_meaning: A region or part of a town, a country, or the surface of something.
78.example: The given map covers a rural and semi-urban area.

79.english_meaning: Relating to the detailed mapping or description of the physical features of an area.
79.hindi_meaning: स्थलाकृतिक (किसी क्षेत्र की भौतिक विशेषताओं का विस्तृत मानचित्रण)

79.english_meaning: Places where people have built homes and established a community.
79.hindi_meaning: बस्तियां (वह स्थान जहाँ लोग घर बनाकर रहते हैं)

79.example: Study the extract for topographical sheet 63K/12 carefully.

79.english_meaning: Belonging to or relating to geography or the Earth's surface features.

79.example: Name the geographical feature represented by white patches in the river.

79.english_meaning: Plants considered collectively, especially those found in a particular area.

79.english_meaning: The course along which someone or something moves.

79.english_meaning: A rectangular piece of paper, especially one forming part of a map series.
79.hindi_meaning: पत्रक / पृष्ठ (मानसिक या कागज़ की बड़ी शीट)
79.example: Topographical sheet 63K/12 covers a specific area.

79.hindi_meaning: धब्बे / टुकड़े (अलग दिखने वाले छोटे क्षेत्र)

79.english_meaning: Moving steadily and continuously in a current or stream.

80.english_meaning: Learning and applying concepts through hands-on activities, experiments, or fieldwork rather than just theory.

80.english_meaning: The study of the physical features of the earth and its atmosphere, and of human activity as it affects and is affected by these.

80.english_meaning: An area of a country or state that has been defined for official or administrative purposes.

80.english_meaning: A scale on a map shown as a ratio or fraction, representing the ratio of map distance to ground distance.

80.english_meaning: The angular distance of a place north or south of the earth's equator, measured in degrees.

80.english_meaning: The detailed inspection or investigation of an area of land to gather data for making maps.

81.hindi_meaning: दूरसंवेदन (बिना भौतिक संपर्क के किसी वस्तु या घटना की जानकारी प्राप्त करने की तकनीक)

81.english_meaning: Relating to, produced by, or used in photography.

81.example: Sensors can detect various types of radiations reflected from the Earth's surface.
